relevant_laws.quote: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway, unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct pedestrian steady-red highway-entry duty with referenced other-device exception
relevant_laws.notes: The assigned branch fixes pedestrian highway entry at a traffic signal. The base catalog cell alone does not establish the signal face or public highway boundary; the construction must prove both.
